item.sophisticated_smeltery.spawner_upgr: Runs one spawner using its native rules. With a Mob Catcher, spawns prefer backpack storage.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.advanced_spa: Ignores player distance and natural spawn rules. Space, nearby limits, delay and redstone control still apply.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.spawner_slot: Place one spawner here. The upgrade switch pauses spawning.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.scorched_all: Alloys fluids independently alongside melting upgrades. Includes an output tank and a 3x3 component grid for eight input tanks and one fuel slot.
error.sophisticated_smeltery.empty_alloy: Empty the output, ingredient and fuel tanks before removing this upgrade.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.alloyer_switc: Pause or resume alloying and fuel consumption. Remaining paid burn time is preserved.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.alloyer_targe: Click to select the container target: output or inputs 1–8. You can also use containers directly on each fluid display.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.alloyer_input: Input tank %s: install one tank accepted by the alloyer tank tag.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.alloyer_fuel_: Fuel slot (ninth slot): insert solid fuel or a fuel tank. Backpack tanks can also supply liquid fuel.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.advanced_tra: Switch between Transmute, Smeltery and Foundry modes and toggle alloying independently.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.transmute_all: Click to toggle. Alloying requires heating to be enabled.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.advanced_sea: Pours manually or automatically, preferring the furnace's bottom fluid before tank upgrades.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.seared_casti: Uses Tinkers' casting recipes, preferring the furnace's bottom fluid before tank upgrades.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.scorched_cas: Casts using scorched table or basin rules. Requires a cast; lock it to refill from storage.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.advanced_sco: Pours manually or automatically using scorched casting rules. Lock a cast to refill from storage.
error.sophisticated_smeltery.empty_casti: Return remaining casting fluid or finish cooling before removing this upgrade.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.cast_mode_loc: Return the fluid or finish cooling before switching modes.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.cast_no_contr: Install a melting controller or tank upgrade to pour or return fluid.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.cast_output_h: Storage prefers non-melting slots. The output slot stacks identical items and data, waiting when full.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.cast_lock_hin: Remembers this cast's item and data; refills it from storage after use. Click again to unlock.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.melting_upgr: Melts backpack items using the bound controller's rules.
error.sophisticated_smeltery.one_control: Only one melting controller can be installed.
error.sophisticated_smeltery.bind_contro: Bind a supported controller before installing this upgrade.
error.sophisticated_smeltery.empty_fluid: Empty the furnace and Tinkers fuel tanks before removing the controller.
gui.sophisticated_smeltery.transfer_hint: Left: tank to furnace. Right: furnace to tank.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_spaw: Runs one spawner at the storage position using its native rules.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_adva: Ignores player distance and natural spawn rules. Space, nearby limits, delay and redstone control still apply.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_scor: Alloys fluids independently alongside melting upgrades. Includes an output tank and a 3x3 component grid for eight input tanks and one fuel slot.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_adva: Switch between Transmute, Smeltery and Foundry modes and toggle alloying independently.
Pours manually or automatically, preferring the furnace's bottom fluid before tank upgrades.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_sear: Uses Tinkers' casting recipes, preferring the furnace's bottom fluid before tank upgrades.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_scor: Casts using scorched table or basin rules. Requires a cast; lock it to refill from storage.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_adva: Pours manually or automatically using scorched casting rules. Lock a cast to refill from storage.
item.sophisticated_smeltery.storage_melt: Melts storage items using the bound controller's rules.
